description: List SMS delivery requests of the last 90 days (GET /sms/v2/services/{serviceId}/messages). Requires requestId, or requestStartTime+requestEndTime (≤30 days), or completeStartTime+completeEndTime (≤24 h). Paginate with nextToken. An empty HTTP 404 reply means no matching records for this service (observed live 2026-09), not a wrong path.

completeEndTime.description: Window end by completion time (within 24 hours of start)

completeStartTime.description: Window start by completion time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'

nextToken.description: Page token from the previous response

requestEndTime.description: Window end by request time (SMS: within 30 days, Alimtalk/Brand: within 31 days of start)

requestId.description: Request ID from the send response. One of requestId, requestStartTime+requestEndTime, completeStartTime+completeEndTime is required

requestStartTime.description: Window start by request time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'

serviceId.description: SMS service ID in NRN form (e.g. ncp:sms:kr:1********2:myproject). Defaults to NCLOUD_SENS_SMS_SERVICE_ID / NCLOUD_SENS_SERVICE_ID. Find it with ncloud_sens_list_projects (smsService.serviceId). A 'Forbidden' reply means the project does not have this channel enabled.

name: ncloud_sens_list_sms_requests
